content:
Welcome to week 16 everyone! We are only a month away from meeting at Devcon, hope you are all ready to wrap up your projects this month. 

We have still couple weeks of work ahead of us and by end of October, you should be ready to finalize your projects with final report and project presentation. I will share the full schedule with deadlines and details soon. For now, join us for regular standup updates as always, 3pm utc! See you in an hour
